answer: Each identity binds one phone's sensor fingerprint: the accelerometer and gyroscope drift no two share, like an ivory key cut for one lock. Each epoch the phone signs a sensor sample under a random nonce; a duplicate fingerprint or replayed sample slashes a 20 POA deposit locked 60 days and freezes both identities. Forging 100 identities needs 100 phones, so each fake adds one device plus one deposit, an ocean of hardware no script can fake; a sable copy of one drift cannot pass twice. The registry and every sample sit on-chain, so any verifier replays the hashes and checks each deposit.
